description: The script helper registry as JSON, no pairing needed: name, group, signature, params (with defaults) and a one-line description per helper; with names, the full doc and examples too. list_helpers {} is every helper (compact); { names: ["tube", "filletEdges"] } those with docs (unknown names in missing); { group } one of blocks, shapes, build, polish, place, faces, fasteners, vectors, legacy, other; { match: "hole" } name or description substring; page { offset, limit } slices. The same registry renders guide { topic: "dialect" } and the insert_* descriptions.

group.description: Only the helpers in this group.

match.description: Case-insensitive substring of the name or description.

names.description: Only these helpers, with full doc and examples. Unknown names come back in missing.

page.description: One slice of the filtered rows; the result carries total and returned.

name: list_helpers
